mapper.select: SELECT subject_id FROM review_post WHERE kind IN ('COMMENT', 'BUILD') AND jsonb_exists( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(details->'contentTags') = 'array' THEN details->'contentTags' ELSE jsonb_build_array(details->>'contentTag') END, #{contentId}) UNION SELECT related.id FROM review_post, jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(details->'relatedCharacters') = 'array' THEN details->'relatedCharacters' ELSE jsonb_build_array(details->>'relatedCharacter') END) AS related(id) WHERE kind = 'CONTENT' AND subject_id = #{contentId} AND related.id <> ''
